purpose: Derive GW008 season 1 league champions from standings
sql: SELECT competition_key, team_name, played, points, gd FROM (SELECT competition_key, team_name, COUNT(*) played, SUM(points) points, SUM(gf-ga) gd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY competition_key ORDER BY SUM(points) DESC, SUM(gf-ga) DESC, SUM(gf) DESC, team_name) rn FROM (SELECT competition_key, home_name team_name, home_score gf, away_score ga, CASE WHEN home_score>away_score THEN 3 WHEN home_score=away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END points FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND sm_action='league' AND match_date BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-08-29' UNION ALL SELECT competition_key, away_name team_name, away_score gf, home_score ga, CASE WHEN away_score>home_score THEN 3 WHEN away_score=home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END points FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND sm_action='league' AND match_date BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-08-29') m GROUP BY competition_key,team_name) s WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY competition_key
